result.summary: Several layout and styling problems: category pills and restaurant cards are clipped, a popular restaurant card is cut off, and the bottom tab bar is missing an icon.

issues.description: The last category filter chip is cut off at the right edge of the screen, so the full set of categories is not visible.
issues.suggestion: Allow the category row to scroll horizontally with padding or fade so the last chip is fully readable, or wrap/resize chips to fit.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in “Fastest near you” (Trattoria Piccol) is cropped so the name and image are truncated.
issues.suggestion: Give cards consistent width with horizontal scroll, or scale the grid so names and images are fully visible.

issues.description: The second “Popular right now” restaurant card is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, hiding the restaurant name and details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding above the tab bar so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The Orders tab in the bottom navigation has a label but no icon, unlike Home, Search, and Profile.
issues.suggestion: Add a matching bag/receipt icon for Orders so the tab bar is consistent.

issues.description: The “See all” links sit far to the right of their section titles with a large empty gap.
issues.suggestion: Tighten the header alignment so the title and action feel like one row.
